data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 5.0 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. Improvements of GBP 0.9 million on motor, GBP 16.9 million on fire and other damage to property and GBP 2.2 million on pecuniary loss were partially offset by deteriorations of GBP 6.0 million on third party liability, GBP 2.5 million on energy, GBP 3.3 million on reinsurance acceptances and GBP 3.0 million on marine, aviation and transport.

named_events.loss_description: Very severe winter storm and freeze, named Uri, hit the US state of Texas causing around US$15 billion of insured damage.
Largest single loss event, hit the United States in August causing an estimated total insured loss of around US$36 billion. The largest event loss incurred by Syndicate 2121 was from Hurricane Ida.
Extremely damaging flood hit central Europe in July which caused around US$13 billion of insured damage.
Terrible outbreak of tornadoes across the US Mid-West.
Wildfire in Denver, occurring 'out of season' in December 2021.

data.standardized_narrative: For the 2021 financial year, Syndicate 2121 experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 10.6 million, calculated from the claims development triangle. This contrasts with the net improvement of GBP 5.0 million reported in the movement note, which also detailed various line of business movements. The prior year development was influenced by adverse court rulings and legal developments related to COVID-19 business interruption claims affecting the 2018 and 2019 years of account, leading to a declared loss for the 2018 year of account and the 2019 year of account remaining open with a forecast loss. The 2020 year of account also showed disappointing development against initial expectations.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development amount is calculated from the gross claims development triangle on page 19, as the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note on page 11 provides a net figure. LOB movements for prior year development are net of reinsurance, as gross figures were not provided in the breakdown.
